topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I opened the front door to find a neatly wrapped package on the mat, my name and address clearly written in crisp, clean strokes. A bit puzzled, I brought it inside and carefully examined it. The return address revealed it belonged to the previous tenant, someone I hadn’t met but whose life here seemed to echo through the walls. I decided to take a moment to trace their path, perhaps find a way to return it. As I looked up their details, I felt a connection to this unseen person, a shared moment in time through a simple, misplaced delivery. I’ll send it back with a note, maybe a touch of kindness can turn this mix-up into something meaningful.
